title: Chapter 234
text:
The impact of the war was very far-reaching. Other than Andrea, all the major forces in Blue Star had different reactions. Most of the people were terrified.

Just like how Han Xiao copied Bennett's declaration, the wounds from the old era were torn open, awakening the fear in people's hearts that had not yet dissipated. Everyone in society paid close attention to the direction of the war, and it also affected the people at the bottom. The Germinal Organization's flag was to overthrow the Six Nations. There were many survivors of the old era in the world. Their mentality was very complicated and indescribable.

At the same time, the brutality of the war seemed to be contagious. Violent incidents appeared all over the world. Bandits in the wild took advantage of the chaos to commit crimes, forcing the wanderers to migrate on a large scale. This was a good thing for the Dark Net. The shelter plan was immediately successful, and the three shelters attracted a wave of residents.

Other than the Southern Continent, the players in the Western Continent and the Northern Continent who did not participate in the expedition mission and sanctuary mission also received other benefits. There were many missions in this chaotic world, which satisfied their needs.

…

[Dust of the Fallen Seeds]: Current Progress: 27.1%

The whole world was paying attention to the war, including the neutral Dark Net. Han Xiao, who was far away in Sanctuary Three, was also paying attention to the information. He had two sources of information. One was the strategic situation collected by the Dark Net, and the other was the battle footage shared by the expedition players on the forums.

The war had been going on for more than ten days. The situation was changing rapidly. Han Xiao's progress of the Germinal Organization's main storyline mission, which had been stagnant for a long time, increased by five percent and was still rising.

The information he leaked to the Six Nations could be counted as his indirect achievement. He could share part of the progress.

The flames of war raged in the distance, and Han Xiao watched from afar. The prototype of Sanctuary Three also took shape during this period of time.

The players were overjoyed. They felt a sense of pride and accomplishment. This was the city that they had participated in building. A sense of belonging was born.

Different from the overjoyed players, the residents in the sanctuary were affected by the atmosphere of the war. They felt slightly relieved that the sanctuary was taking shape, but they were more worried about the future.

The war affected people all over the world. The only ones who were not affected by the atmosphere were the players.

That was because they did not need to think about the future.

The more chaotic the world was, the happier the players were.

Han Xiao had obtained the short-term reward for completing the Sanctuary's Main Storyline, which was sixty-one days ahead of the deadline. He had received an additional 610% EXP reward, which was a total of 5.68 million EXP. This was the most EXP reward he had ever received.

The other rewards were the relationship with the Dark Net. Favorability + 1250, reaching [Respect].

The overall rating of [Sanctuary Three] jumped from D- to B-, which showed that it was done perfectly this time.

The short-term goal was no longer updated, which meant that from now on, there would be no instructions. In order to complete the [Sanctuary Three] mission, he would have to complete the entire sanctuary. The higher the requirements of the mission, the higher the final mission evaluation.

At this time, the construction of the shelter was on the right track. Han Xiao did not need to worry at all. He just left it there and let it build on its own.

Beep beep!

Bennett called and sounded surprised.

"The initial construction of Sanctuary Three has been completed?!"

Han Xiao laughed. "Praise me."

Bennett choked for a long time before he finally calmed down. He said in a helpless tone, "Seriously, the progress of Sanctuary Three has surpassed Sanctuary One. With the help of the Inhumans, you might be able to make Sanctuary Three be the first to be completed. Keep it going. I have high hopes for Sanctuary Three … You know, with the outbreak of war, the wilderness is not safe, and the mass migration of wanderers will come in handy. Try to take in as many people as possible."

Han Xiao nodded and jotted it down on a piece of paper. He planned to let Huang Yu worry about it later.

The upper echelons of the Dark Net could not believe this result. The progress of the so-called Sanctuary Three had surpassed Sanctuary One. How did this make sense?

The use of the Inhumans was shown. The Dark Net got inspiration from Han Xiao and planned to hire some Inhumans as workers. This was beneficial for the entire Sanctuary Project.

Bennett said a few more words and hung up the phone. He was also paying attention to the war, but he did not talk much about this issue. Because the Dark Net was neutral, there was no need for them to get involved.

However, he did not know Han Xiao's plan.

The war has started, and the Germinal Organization can't even take care of itself. I can go take a look around. Han Xiao thought. He had been waiting for this opportunity.

He had three goals. First, to obtain the direct progress of [Dust of the Fallen Seeds] and increase the completion rate.

Second, to save Aurora and free the future super strong Hella. It would be best if he could form a good relationship with Hella. He had been keeping this matter in his heart, waiting for a good opportunity. Now was undoubtedly the best time to save her.

The Germinal Organization headquarters should be very defenseless.

The third goal was about his own growth, and it had to be completed in the Germinal Organization headquarters.

Han Xiao planned to act alone without bringing anyone. This was the only way to be stealthy and agile. Andrea had become the battlefield, so it was easy for him to sneak through the fire zone and the Germinal Organization's defense circle and find his way to the headquarters.

His confidence came from the fact that he had finally improved his strength.

Class Advancement Requirements: Complete five purple equipment with Energy Rank 60 and above. Progress: 5/5

Class Advancement Successful!

You have received a new class [Magnetic Ring Mechanic Lv.1]. + 70 Energy, + 2 DEX, + 1 END, + 4 INT. You have received 4 Free Attribute Points. You have received 1 Potential Point.

You have learned the skill [Advanced Machinery Affinity]!

You have learned the skill [Surging Mechanical Force]!

You have learned the skill [Electromagnetic Energy Extraction]!

You have learned the talent [Energy Modification]!

Magnetic Ring Mechanics, also known as Beginner Mechanics, were beyond the scope of apprenticeship. They had pushed open the door of the Super Mechanic class and come into contact with the bizarre scenes behind the door.

The characteristic of a Magnetic Ring Mechanic was to use the electromagnetic energy in the construction of machinery on a large scale to increase the affinity of machinery, greatly increasing efficiency and quality. It was more like the style of a Super.

After becoming a Magnetic Ring Mechanic, the energy of the Mechanic class was called [Mechanical Force], and it was used in all aspects of machinery. The new skill he had learned, [Surging Mechanical Force], was to increase the power of the machinery by expending energy. It was similar to Overload, but it was continuous and did little damage to the machinery. It was considered a shallow use of Mechanical Force and a prerequisite for more advanced skills.

[Electromagnetic Energy Extraction] was similar to [Energy Modification], a growth skill that increased energy. It was limited to one hundred refinements, and the effect was dependent on one's Intelligence. The only difference was that this skill was exclusive to Mechanics.

[Energy Modification] was a talent, and its introduction said, 'You have found the trick to the construction of machinery, combining energy in every part of the construction process.' The effect of the skill was to increase the efficiency and quality of the machinery according to the energy value. This was one of the characteristics of a Magnetic Ring Mechanic, and it was a very core talent of the Mechanic class. For example, his current energy was more than 1,600 points, and it could increase his efficiency by 20 to 25 percent.

A cool feeling flowed out from his brain and spread throughout his body. Many thoughts collided in his mind. After completing the Class Advancement, Han Xiao closed his eyes comfortably. He could feel the obvious changes, and his control of machinery had increased once again.

A brand new class with stronger abilities!

"I've finally completed the Class Advancement." Han Xiao secretly clenched his fists, and excitement surged in his heart. The huge amount of EXP on his interface could finally be used again.

[Magnetic Ring Mechanic] required 3,500,000 EXP to level up from Level 1 to Level 2, which was three times that of [Trainee Mechanic] from Level 14 to Level 15. The higher the level of the class, the more EXP it would take to level up.

Without hesitation, Han Xiao immediately leveled up [Magnetic Ring Mechanic] to Level 5. Without even blinking, he spent 20,000,000 EXP!

How rich!

His total level had reached Level 60!

LV 60 Promotion Mission [The Limit Trial]: Push yourself to the limit in battle and feel the sublimation of life.

Mission Requirements: Obtain 2000 Trial Points. Current Points: 0/2000

Trial Points are obtained by killing enemies. The stronger the enemy, the more Trial Points you will receive. The more difficult the process of winning (based on HP), the more trial points will be awarded.]

"As expected, I'm not a player. The version has no restrictions on me." Han Xiao had expected this, but he still could not help but feel overjoyed.

This meant that as long as he completed the Promotion Mission, he would become the only person on this planet to break through the LV 60 barrier!

He would stand at the top of the entire Blue Star, a peak that no one could reach!

Just thinking about it made Han Xiao very excited.

His vision was not limited to the planet but the entire universe.

This type of Promotion Mission requires a large number of battles and monsters. I'll have to see what kind of enemies will give me Trial Points. Hmm … Low-level enemies definitely won't do. I'll definitely need high-level enemies, Han Xiao thought to himself.

Since he was going to the Andrea Continent, he could try to complete the Promotion Mission while he was at it. Only the battlefield would gather strong people, and only then would he be able to show off his skills.

Along the way, he could also attack the Germinal Organization. This was Han Technician's usual style.

Putting this matter aside for now, Han Xiao allocated all his Free Attribute Points to Intelligence.

After that, he invested 25,000,000 EXP and leveled up [Advanced Machinery Affinity] and [Surging Mechanical Force] to the maximum.

The sea of EXP that he had accumulated finally had a use.

Seeing the EXP slowly turning into his own strength, Han Technician felt very fulfilled.

Looking at the interface, his Energy Rank had exceeded the 2,000 mark, and his Grade had reached Grade C!
